/* isry.couns.constt.sndng.mapper.SndngMapper.selectSndngHistbList - 개발지원팀 이태호 */
SELECT b.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM ,b.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT ,b.EML_ADDR_ENCPT AS EML_ADDR_ENCPT ,TO_CHAR(b.FRST_REG_DT,'YYYYMMDD') AS FRST_REG_DT ,a.WRTR_TELNO AS WRTR_TELNO ,a.EML_SNDNG_YMD AS EML_SNDNG_YMD ,a.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT2 ,a.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID FROM AYE120 a /* 사이버상담답글 */ ,AYE100 b /* 사이버상담게시글 */ WHERE 1=1 AND a.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = b.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND a.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = b.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND a.EML_SNDNG_YN IS NOT NULL AND b.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03'
AND b.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{STARTDT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(#{ENDDT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND b.WRTR_NM_ENCPT LIKE '%' || #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
AND b.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%'
ORDER BY a.FRST_REG_DT
